verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a state filing office could publish an account-free or file-number entry path into online filing. The evidence pack never documents one. The FileDoc.do pages only list filing types (LLC, corporation, name reservation, conversions), with no statement that filing proceeds without creating an account or by entering a file number. The keyless probe hits a Socrata open-data API, not the filing flow, so it does not transfer to this story.
